name: KEDA Self-Hosted
free_limit: Apache-2.0 Kubernetes event-driven autoscaler for containers and jobs; scales workloads from zero replicas based on queue lengths, events, and external metrics, without a software-side request or replica quota.
watch_out: Requires an existing Kubernetes cluster, compatible metrics/event sources and operating capacity; worker nodes, cloud event services and monitoring can incur charges. KEDA is an autoscaling component, not a hosted function runtime.
